MAX_MC_FAIL_COUNT

public static int MAX_MC_FAIL_COUNT
Maximum allowable successive failures for fluid substitution Successive attempts that fail more than this number of times almost certainly indicate unphysical rock or fluid data.

LAYER_PINCHOUT_THRESHOLD

public static final double LAYER_PINCHOUT_THRESHOLD
Standardised deviate threshold to determine whether a layer seems likely to pinchout, and therefore whether to seek a local mode in the likelihood surface assuming time-starting points that impose the pinchout of the layer in question. This is a threshold for the layer time-thickness std deviation over the mean layer time-thickness. If it's Gaussian, a factor of less than 0.33 indicates 99% chance of not being pinched out. 0.5 Corresponds to 95%.
